name: Interval-Compressed VDC / IE (Ewing Sarcoma)

premedications.name: Mesna
premedications.notes: Divided IV doses or continuous infusion for uroprotection

supportiveCare: Filgrastim (G-CSF) or pegfilgrastim mandatory after every cycle for 14-day interval compression
monitoring: CBC with diff, CMP, urinalysis (check for hematuria)

drugs.name: vinCRIStine
drugs.notes: vinCRIStine 1.5 mg/m2 (cap 2 mg) IV push on Day 1 of VDC cycles.

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin
drugs.notes: DOXOrubicin 75 mg/m2 IV over 48 hours or continuous infusion on VDC cycles.

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide
drugs.notes: Cyclophosphamide 1200 mg/m2 IV over 1 hour with Mesna on VDC cycles.

drugs.name: Ifosfamide
drugs.notes: Ifosfamide 1800 mg/m2/day IV over 1 hour with Mesna on Days 1-5 of IE cycles.

drugs.name: Etoposide
drugs.notes: Etoposide 100 mg/m2/day IV over 2 hours on Days 1-5 of IE cycles.
